how_to_read: The kit only installs a file whose SHA-256 matches one of these lines. 'verified_by' says how that hash was checked on 2026-11-14.

stock_launcher.source: https://github.com/ohernandezdev/android-tv-tune/blob/main/docs/launcher.md (one source, one TV: the setup wizard package must also be turned off or it takes over the Home button)

any.verified_by: downloaded and hashed by the kit builder

youtube.name: SmartTube (stable)
youtube.notice: The SmartTube author says that in the past his computer was infected and a few builds may have been affected (see the top of https://github.com/yuliskov/SmartTube). That is why this kit only installs a file whose fingerprint matches the one written down here.

arm64-v8a.verified_by: downloaded and hashed by the kit builder; matches the GitHub release digest

armeabi-v7a.verified_by: downloaded and hashed by the kit builder; matches the GitHub release digest

universal.verified_by: downloaded and hashed by the kit builder; matches the GitHub release digest
